# Unseen-place test campaign

*Generated by `scripts/run_unseen_places.py` from each run's results.json; nothing typed by hand.*

Robustness and plausibility only: these places have no reference map in this project. Accuracy is measured once, on the case study (validation/results.md).
Boxes are approximate, from general geography, not from any flood or damage map.

## Notes

- **thessaly_2023**: re-run 2026-10-14 after the huge-flood speed fixes (first attempt stopped after 2 h in the cut-off stage); downloads mostly from the cache; 51 of the 62 minutes were later passes, slowed by dropped connections that the new retry logic recovered.
- **rio_grande_do_sul_2024**: no Sentinel-1 image exists over this area between February and the flood (only one Sentinel-1 satellite in 2024): the system reports this instead of inventing a map.
- **kathmandu_2024**: re-run 2026-10-14 after the retry fix (first attempt: terrain download broke on a dropped connection) and the landing-zone memory fix (second attempt: > 6 GB, stopped); downloads mostly from the cache.

## Invalid inputs (must give a clear answer, never a traceback)

| Case | Exit | Traceback | Answer |
|---|---|---|---|
| future date | 0 | no | run completed; s1 failed: No Sentinel-1 IW scenes with VV polarisation over this area in the search window. The flood date 2026-12-01 is today or in the future: no image after it yet. |
| date before Sentinel-1 | 0 | no | run completed; s1 failed: No Sentinel-1 IW scenes with VV polarisation over this area in the search window. The flood date 2012-06-01 is before Sentinel-1 began routine observations (October 2014). |
| open sea | 0 | no | run completed; terrain failed: No Copernicus DEM elevation data for this area (open sea, or outside the DEM coverage): terrain masks, the confidence map and everything that depends on them cannot be computed. |
| tiny area | 2 | no | error: AOI is 0.01 km², smaller than the 0.5 km² minimum. |
| huge area | 2 | no | error: AOI is 175,957 km², larger than the 2,500 km² limit. Please choose a smaller area (e.g. one valley reach). |
| inverted box | 2 | no | error: bbox order must be [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat] with min < max (boxes crossing the antimeridian are not supported) |
| bad date text | 2 | no | floodmap run: error: argument --date: date must be YYYY-MM-DD, got '2024-13-40' |
| missing date | 2 | no | error: --date is required with --bbox |
